svg.title: inversion double crossover problem
svg.desc: Four chromatids. Normal order cen A B C D E. Inverted homolog is shown reversed as e b c d a cen, corresponding to cen a d c b e. First crossover between B and C; second crossover requested between C and D.

g.text: First crossover: between B/b and C/c
Only the inverted region is shown paired; ends are unpaired.
